name: Lesotho (1966–1987)
description: A blue field with a white mokorotlo, the conical Basotho hat, in the centre and two narrow vertical stripes of green and red at the hoist.
history: Adopted on 4 October 1966, the day of independence from the United Kingdom, with the colours of the Basotho National Party: blue for the sky and rain, white for peace, green for the land and red for faith. It was replaced on 20 January 1987 after the military coup that removed the BNP government.
